stem: Benito wants a better closing sentence for his paper. Which sentence should replace sentence 36?

options.label: A
options.text: In the future I would know just what to do in an unexpected rainstorm.

options.label: B
options.text: Next summer I hope my family can avoid storms when we visit the Grand Canyon.

options.label: C
options.text: Tomorrow I was looking forward to a day without any storms or rain.

options.label: D
options.text: I bet you wish you had a special aunt who could teach you new things about rainstorms.
